included.name: Functional sorting
included.description: One functional predictor per direction ranks the full peptide library. Which predictor is used depends on the direction: the antioxidant direction is ranked by AnOxPePred's free-radical-scavenging head, antimicrobial by iMFP-LG's AMP channel, anti-melanin by TIPred, and anti-inflammatory by iMFP-LG's AIP channel.

included.name: Safety hard-threshold screening
included.output: Peptides passing all assessed veto gates
included.description: Three veto checks, applied with the pipeline's null-passthrough rule: a metric eliminates a candidate only when it is present and out of bounds, and an unassessed metric does not eliminate anything. Toxicity below 0.38 (ToxinPred3), haemolysis below 0.55 (HemoPI2), and MHC-I presentation under the route's own gate (MHCflurry). There is no weighted compensation — a single failure removes the candidate. This round is the pipeline bottleneck: ToxinPred3 inference is single-threaded and takes roughly a day.

included.name: Developability scoring
included.description: Four developability signals combined into a composite by a Winsorized standard-deviation weighting: components with high spread — genuinely discriminative within the candidate pool — are up-weighted, and flat components are down-weighted automatically. No manual weight preset is involved, which is why the weights differ between directions.

included.name: Enumeration and assembly
included.description: Ranked peptides are fused onto scaffolds with a linker to produce complete construct sequences. The platform currently carries 496 constructs across four directions; the binding between a construct and a real scaffold is still a placeholder pending assembly against the scaffold library.

excluded.name: 3D folding prediction
excluded.description: Predicts 3D structures. Excluded from the MVP: computationally heavy, and silk GGX-repeat sequences yield inherently low confidence (around 0.42 pLDDT) under these methods, so the output would not support a decision.

excluded.name: Structure evaluation
excluded.description: Solvent-accessible surface area and 3D aggregation propensity from predicted structures. Excluded with Round 5, on which it depends.

excluded.name: Structure-based ranking
excluded.description: The second of the two definitions of a composite score in the old frontend: 40% SASA + 40% (1 - Aggrescan3D) + 20% pLDDT. Excluded with Rounds 5 and 6. The composite the platform reports is not this one.

excluded.name: AlphaFold3 validation
excluded.description: Optional high-accuracy structural validation of a small number of constructs. Excluded from the MVP with the rest of the structure track.

composite_definition: The composite this platform reports is the Round 3 definition: a Winsorized standard-deviation weighting over the developability components, recomputed per application route because each route carries a different weighting profile. The components, their normalised values and the weight each received are returned with every score so the number can be reproduced by hand. This remains an exploratory ranking: the model signals are not all calibrated for short peptides, and the composite does not establish activity, fusion-protein safety or experimental success.
excluded_note: Rounds 5-8 concern 3D structure and are out of MVP scope. Because Round 7 also produced something called a composite score, the old frontend carried two definitions of the same term simultaneously; only the Round 3 definition is implemented here.
